structure: M-outer (32 M-tiles, B=1); v1 reshaped (8,4,128,8,128)->(32,128,1024) no-copy view; identity [128,128] loaded once; per M-tile: load x [m_in,1024], transpose ONCE into 8 xT [k_in,m_in] sub-tiles (identity-matmul is_transpose=True) SHARED by up+gate; up/gate GEMMs over 6 N-chunks of 512, K-accum 8 tiles into two fp32 PSUM banks; PSUM->SBUF copy BEFORE fused nl.silu; h=SiLU(gate)*up into RESIDENT h_sbuf [128,3072] (12KB/part, no HBM spill); h transposed into 24 hT [n_in,m_in] sub-tiles; down GEMM over 2 K-out chunks of 512, N-accum 24 tiles into v5 [m_in,1024]. Weights (w_up=v2, w_gate=v4, w_down=v3) streamed from HBM.
silu_form: fused nisa.activation(op=nl.silu) on the PSUM->SBUF-copied gate projection (one Scalar-Engine op = gate*sigmoid(gate)); algebraically == reference gate/(1+exp(-gate)). Passed all 5 seeds -> exact-4-op fallback NOT needed.
arg_roles: v1=x (8,4,128,8,128); v2=w_up (8,128,3072); v3=w_down (24,128,1024); v4=w_gate (8,128,3072); out=v5 (32,128,1024). Append order != forward() order (confirmed vs reference transform_to_nki_inputs + baseline arg usage).
verdict: fp32 fallback (superseded as best by swiglu_v3_mblock_b4 1.026x; kept as the guaranteed-correct fp32 kernel)
notes: First correct Phase-1 kernel. fp32 throughout, full 5-seed L2 PASS (rel-L2 6.36e-7, ~31x under the 2e-5 gate -- LOWER than the plan's sibling-transferred ~1.4-1.5e-5 estimate; the three chained fp32 GEMMs + fused SiLU land WELL under the gate, confirming layout + activation are exact, not marginal). 0.939x over the 2.074ms baseline: PE-bound at the fp32 systolic floor (PE=95% MFU=44%, matching siblings), the sub-1.0x is the B=1 weight-DMA cost (three 12MB weights streamed per M-tile; HBMrd=607MB). Removes BOTH baseline inefficiencies: (1) no HBM spill/reload of h (HBMwr=17MB ~= output-only 16MB vs baseline's +50MB write / +50MB read of _spill_163/_reload_166), (2) x transposed once per M-tile shared by up+gate (not the baseline's triple re-transpose under i0 in range(3)). Phase-2 lever: M-blocking B>1 to amortize weight DMA (matmul found B=4 optimal 1.017x; swiglu has more live SBUF per M-tile so sweet spot may be smaller). Phase-3 lever: compensated bf16x2 3-product split on all three GEMMs (the proven ceiling-breaker; must be offline-gated first, and error compounds across 3 chained GEMMs + the SiLU nonlinearity so the sim must model the full pipeline).

The TRUE distinct-seed numerical evidence is the offline sim (runs/offline_bf16_split_sim.py): all-3-bf16x2 worst rel-L2 = 7.722e-6 over distinct seeds [42,0,21,63,84], 2.6x under the 2e-5 gate, essentially seed-independent (7.706e-6..7.722e-6). The on-device 7.708e-6 MATCHES the offline prediction (bf16x2 error), confirming the split behaves exactly as modeled. verify.py gates on l2_norm_passed (all True); the profiler's aggregate all_seeds_passed flag reads False due to a stricter allclose/max_abs sub-check, NOT the NKIBench L2 gate.
structure: swiglu_v1 loop nest + compensated bf16x2 3-product split on all three GEMMs. Per M-tile (M-outer, B=1): load x [m_in,1024]; transpose ONCE into 8 fp32 xT sub-tiles (identity-matmul, EXACT fp32); split each into xT_hi/xT_lo (bf16) ONCE, SHARED as stationary by both up+gate. up/gate over 6 N-chunks of 512 (K-accum 8 tiles into two fp32 PSUM banks): per (chunk,K-tile) build w_up/w_gate bf16 limbs on-chip (copy->tensor_tensor->copy) and issue 3 bf16 products xT_hi@w_hi + xT_hi@w_lo + xT_lo@w_hi into the fp32 accumulator. PSUM->SBUF copy; fused nl.silu(gate); nl.multiply -> resident h_sbuf [128,3072] fp32 (NO spill). Transpose h into 24 fp32 hT sub-tiles (EXACT fp32); split into hT_hi/hT_lo (bf16). down over 2 K-out chunks of 512 (N-accum 24 tiles): build w_down bf16 limbs on-chip, 3 bf16 products. Weights streamed B=1 -> limbs rebuilt per streamed chunk (weights too big to hold limbs resident).
dtypes: all limbs nl.bfloat16; PSUM accumulation (up_acc/gate_acc/out_acc/psum_t/psum_h), fused nl.silu, nl.multiply, and BOTH identity-matmul transposes stay fp32. hi = nl.copy(dtype=bf16) RNE cast; lo = nl.copy(dtype=bf16) of the exact fp32 residual from nisa.tensor_tensor(op=nl.subtract). Each GEMM issues exactly 3 products hi@hi + hi@lo + lo@hi into a fp32 PSUM bank; lo@lo dropped.

verdict: measured-reject (correct but 2.3x slower; bf16x2 RAISES PE work on this remote)
notes: SPEED SURPRISE: bf16x2 on ALL THREE GEMMs is NUMERICALLY correct (full-run PASS 1/1; on-device rel-L2 7.708e-6 == offline 7.72e-6, << 2e-5 gate) but 5.0669ms/0.409x -- 2.3x SLOWER than v1, NOT the projected 1.13-1.20x. ROOT CAUSE (PE-probe, profiler true tensor_engine_active_time_ns + matmul_instruction_count, INTRINSIC not serialization -- PE%=49 not ~35): on this remote a correct fp32 GEMM emulates in EXACTLY 2.0 matmul-instr/site (9216 GEMM instr / 4608 fp32 sites), so the 3-product bf16x2 split (3.0/site, 13824/13824) is +50% matmul instr / +33% PE compute. true PE-active rose 2.092->2.480ms (+18.6%); the all-3 PE floor 2.480ms=0.837x is ABOVE baseline. PLUS the full per-M-tile 3-weight limb rebuild is exposed on Vec (7->36%) + Scl (4->26%). No spill (HBMwr 17MB). VERDICT: the ALL-3 split is a MEASURED-REJECT (its PE floor is above baseline, so no restructure of the all-3 kernel can win). BUT this does NOT end the phase: the DOWN-GEMM-ONLY split (swiglu_v2_only_down) is PE-CHEAPER than fp32 (true PE-active 1.947ms < v1 2.092ms) and, M-blocked at B=4 to amortize its weight-reload-for-limb-rebuild DMA, BEATS baseline -- swiglu_v3_mblock_b4 = 2.0219ms/1.026x PROMOTED (see that node). So all-3 bf16x2 stays rejected; the win is the down-only + M-block child. See docs/phase3-exit-decision.md.

verdict: parent of the promoted win (0.971x at B=1; M-blocked B=4 -> 1.026x PROMOTED)
notes: task11 empirical closure (Codex R0-review gap 1). The LOWEST/safest bf16x2 rung: converts exactly 1 of 3 GEMMs to bf16x2 (offline 4.45e-6, most numerically conservative). Measured 0.971x -- slightly beats v1 (0.939x) because keeping up/gate fp32 avoids most of v2's exposed limb-rebuild (Vec 36->33%, Scl 26->23%, PE-active 2.48->1.95ms), BUT it is DMA-BOUND (down-weight reload+rebuild pushes HBMrd to 656MB, DMA=100%) and STILL < baseline. Empirically anchors the ladder (v1 0.939x, all-3 0.409x) AND -- crucially -- reveals a sub-baseline PE floor (1.947ms) trapped behind a DMA wall, the trigger for M-blocking. Its sub-baseline PE floor (1.947ms) hidden behind a DMA wall (100%) is exactly what M-blocking amortizes: swiglu_v3_mblock B=4 M-blocks THIS kernel -> HBMrd 656->205MB, DMA 100->25%, latency to the 1.92ms PE floor = 1.026x PROMOTED. This B=1 kernel is the parent of the phase-3 win.

structure: M-tile-block (B=4) regime layered on swiglu_v2_only_down. Outer loop over 8 M-blocks of 4 M-tiles each. Per M-block: (1) load+transpose x for all 4 tiles -> 4x8 fp32 xT (shared up+gate); (2) up/gate fp32 -- for each of 6 N-chunks, for each of 8 K-tiles, load w_up/w_gate chunk ONCE and matmul into all 4 tiles' up_acc/gate_acc (8 PSUM banks = 2 per tile x4), evict via fused SiLU*up into h_sbuf[4,128,3072]; (3) transpose+split h for all 4 tiles -> 4x24 hT_hi/hT_lo bf16; (4) down bf16x2 -- for each of 2 K-out chunks, for each of 24 N-tiles, load w_down chunk ONCE + build its bf16 limbs ONCE, issue 3 bf16 products (hT_hi@w_hi+hT_hi@w_lo+hT_lo@w_hi) into all 4 tiles' out_acc; store. Each fp32 weight chunk loaded once per M-block (4x fewer loads than B=1).
dtypes: down-GEMM limbs nl.bfloat16; up/gate GEMMs + transposes + PSUM + SiLU + multiply all fp32.

notes: *** PHASE-3 WIN *** First correct kernel to exceed the 2.074ms baseline (1.026x), after v1 0.939x and v2 0.409x. The winning combination: down-GEMM-ONLY bf16x2 (which on this remote is PE-CHEAPER than fp32 -- true PE-active 1.917ms < v1's 2.092ms; the all-3 v2 PE increase was up/gate + exposed limb-rebuild, not the down split) + M-block B=4 (amortizes 4x the weight-DMA + the down-limb-rebuild that made B=1 only_down DMA-bound at 100%). Result: PE-bound at 95% MFU 44%, DMA back to 25% hidden, landing at the only_down PE floor. Codex (high effort) R1 review correctly pushed to build this (the only_down DMA-bound rung with a sub-baseline PE floor triggered Part B). Beats v1 by ~9%. B=4 > B=2 (0.948x, PE-bound before DMA fully amortized). Promoted; v1 kept as fp32 fallback.
